Capture: live Salesforce Developer scratch org on an authorized Dev Hub
Window: 2026-11-25 04:05–04:10 UTC
CLI: @salesforce/cli/2.159.7
APIs: 62.0 63.0 64.0 65.0 66.0 67.0 68.0
Routes: execute anonymous and deployed @IsTest
Scratch org deletion: confirmed

The profiles.tsv pairs each ran at every listed API on both routes. The
anonymous requests set the scratch user profile in a separate transaction and
checked the locale, language, and GMT from UserInfo in the observation. Each
of the 70 observation requests compiled and succeeded. No observation request
persisted writes.

The deployed classes used one class per API. Tooling API ApexClass.ApiVersion
confirmed all seven class versions. is_test.cls is the class template. Replace
__CLASS__ with Road473Locale plus the API major version. __DATES__ is
observe.apex through the date setup, before the first System.debug. Generate
one __METHODS__ entry per profile and section (0, 1, 2), calling
observe(locale, language, section). The test creates a temporary user in each
test transaction and checks the locale, language and time zone inside runAs.
Each of the 210 tests deliberately asserts with its eight token rows after
checking that all three format overloads agree. The assertions returned the
full expected 24 rows for every API and profile, identical to anonymous Apex.

org.tsv records all 24 samples in observe.apex order. The rows are identical
for every captured profile and API on both routes and for all three overloads,
so the shared token rows appear once. The observation column contains E through
EEEEE, M and L at widths 3–5, and u. Both month families returned English
names, which Glade already rendered. Native weekdays used the hybrid date and
English names for all of these locales at all seven APIs.

NEIGHBOR PROBES
- Previously matched en_CA/en_GB, de_DE/fr_FR EEE/EEEE/u at API 62.0 and 67.0,
  month text, and date samples after the cutover were checked as controls.
- Six or more E characters, u at widths two and up, and locales outside
  profiles.tsv remain on the prior path (including the existing English
  prefix rule). The test pins representative uncaptured forms.
- Numeric month tokens, other format tokens, default formatting, non-GMT
  timezone resolution, and APIs outside 62.0–68.0 were outside this capture.
